
# AMS Portal AI Readiness

AMS Portal is an enterprise infrastructure management platform specialized in high-concurrency VoIP operations and global med-tech supply.

## Key Services
- **VoIP Infrastructure**: Management of VOS3000, VICIBOX, and FusionPBX clusters.
- **Global Pharma Supply**: Secure pharmaceutical distribution hub via USDT.
- **Digital Marketing**: SEO, GMB optimization, and Search Engine Marketing.
- **Reseller Program**: White-label VoIP business solutions.

## Technical Details
- **NOC Monitoring**: Real-time status tracking of global server nodes.
- **Rate Desk**: Wholesale VoIP termination route pricing.
- **Architecture**: Tier-4 enterprise nodes with DDoS protection and NVMe storage.
